QuestInfo.name: Tsuri & the Gourmet Dish
QuestInfo.0: Tsuri of Showa Town apparently is going to make a 'fantastic gourmet dish'. Interesting...
QuestInfo.1: Tsuri said, in order to make the fantastic gourmet dish, he'll need #b100 #t04000157#s#k. I can't wait to see what comes out of this!  #k#n#t04000157#  #b#c04000157##k/100
QuestInfo.2: Gourmet dish? This is nothing more than junk food! *sigh*

0.0: Hey there! Don't you want to try your hands on a fantastic gourmet dish?

yes.0: That's right! No one can resist the sound of someone yelling 'fantastic gourmet dish'. Gather up the ingredients for me, and I'll give you half of what I make out of it.

no.0: Hey, how often do you think you get a chance to eat a fantastic gourmet dish like this? You might want to think again...

1.0: Oooh, that's some fine piece of meat there. With this, I can make the best hotdog you'll ever find.
1.1: Alright, here it is. Eat it before it turns cold.

item.0: I don't think you gathered up all the #b#t4000157#s#k like I asked you to get. Go get them before the sun goes down!
